messages:
Alex: Heads-up — saw a spike in 99th latency alerts this morning. Console fired ~8 notifications for the same route.
Sam: saw it too. The alerts looked noisy. Any idea if threshold too tight or grouping broken?
Alex: Route is /v1/generate-modelX, configured SLO: 99th latency > 450ms for 5m. Alerts grouped by route+model but didn't dedupe.
Rui: We debated per-route vs per-service grouping last week. I think per-route is useful but needs smarter dedupe+fingerprint.
Mike: Agree. If each pod triggers, we blow up paging. We should surface "noisy alerts" in console (count of unique alert sources) and allow mute or auto-batch.
Tess: What about presenting suggested thresholds in UI with noise estimate? e.g., show expected alert rate if we set to X.
Alex: +1. Suggest adding an "expected alert volume" column next to thresholds and a sample recent incidents list.
Sam: Also need notification routing rules — devteam vs oncall. Console should support per-SLO notification policies and "escalation paths".
oncall-bot: Alert aggregation currently groups by route, not instance. We can add a hash by fingerprint for 5m to suppress duplicates.
Rui: Could we add a "test alert" button in the console for each SLO so teams can verify routing/esc? Small UX win.
Mike: Implementation notes: we'll need an events pipeline hook to compute alert fingerprint + noise score. Also store recent alert counts for the window.
Alex: Proposed alert rule snippet:
```yaml
slo: "99p latency /v1/generate-modelX"
threshold: 450ms
window: 5m
group_by: [route, model]
dedupe_fingerprint: "route+model+fingerprint_v2"
notification_policy:
  primary: devteam-pager
  escalation: oncall-sre
noise_threshold: 10 alerts/5m
```

Sam: Nice. For MVP let's default noise_threshold to 20 and expose toggle for aggressive dedupe.
Tess: UX: show mute for 1h/4h/24h and "auto-snooze while rollout" that detects canary deployments.
Rui: Also add rate-limited webhook backends to avoid downstream overload.
Alex: Ok, action items: Rui + Mike to prototype fingerprinting + noise metric; Tess + Sam to wire up UI mockups; I'll add console telemetry counters. PRs due EOW.
Sam: I'll add a short design doc and link here when ready.
Alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
